name: toast
useFor: Prefer Sonner for new work. Use this when an app already uses the toast() and useToast() API: mount one Toaster near the root, call toast({ title, description, action }) and use variant="destructive" for a failure. Give an action an altText that says what it does.
constraints: A toast for an error that needs a decision (use an alert dialog)
source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components (the order card's done step) and sonner.tsx
title: Toast
description: The older Radix toast in the look of the brand's Sonner toasts: a white card at the bottom left with a blue action.
